SELECT SI.RESV_ID FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI WHERE SI.STATUS_CD IN ('INCLUDED', 'HOLD', 'EXCLUDED', 'REFUNDED') AND SI.RESV_ID IN
#{resvId}

SELECT ( NVL(( SELECT SUM( R.TOTAL_AMOUNT - ROUND(R.TOTAL_AMOUNT * NVL(B.FEE_RATE, 10) / 100) ) FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = S.BIZ_NO WHERE S.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI WHERE SI.RESV_ID = R.RESV_ID AND SI.STATUS_CD IN ('INCLUDED', 'HOLD', 'EXCLUDED', 'REFUNDED') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.INQUIRY_TYPE = 'RESERVE' AND I.STATUS_CD = 'WAIT' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( /* 2026/08/06 장우철 — 환불승인(보상숙박) 정산 제외 */ SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.INQUIRY_TYPE = 'RESERVE' AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' AND I.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' ) ), 0) + NVL(( SELECT SUM( R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT - ROUND(R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT * NVL(B.FEE_RATE, 10) / 100) ) FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = S.BIZ_NO WHERE S.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CANCEL' AND NVL(R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI WHERE SI.RESV_ID = R.RESV_ID AND SI.STATUS_CD IN ('INCLUDED', 'HOLD', 'EXCLUDED', 'REFUNDED') ) ), 0) + NVL(( SELECT SUM(ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' AND NVL(ST.PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT' ), 0) ) AS pendingAmount, NVL(( SELECT SUM(ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE' AND ST.PAY_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND ST.PAY_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ), 0) AS paidAmount, NVL(( SELECT SUM(ST.TOTAL_FEE) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' ), 0) AS totalFeeAmount FROM DUAL

SELECT ST.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, ST.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, ST.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, ST.SETTLE_MONTH AS settleMonth, ST.PERIOD_START AS periodStart, ST.PERIOD_END AS periodEnd, ST.TOTAL_SALES AS totalSales, ST.TOTAL_FEE AS totalFee, ST.FEE_AMOUNT AS feeAmount, ST.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, ST.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, ST.SETTLE_STATUS AS settleStatus, ST.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, ST.PAY_DATE AS payDate, ST.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, ST.REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, ST.ROOM_ID AS roomId, ST.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, ST.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND ST.SETTLE_MONTH = #{settleMonth}
AND NVL(ST.PAY_STATUS, 'WAIT') = 'WAIT'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'FAIL'
AND ST.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'
ORDER BY ST.PERIOD_START DESC, ST.SETTLE_ID DESC
SELECT DISTINCT ST.SETTLE_MONTH FROM TB_SETTLEMENT ST WHERE ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' AND ST.SETTLE_MONTH IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST.SETTLE_MONTH DESC

SELECT SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID AS settleItemId, SI.SETTLE_ID AS settleId, NVL(SI.ITEM_TYPE, 'STAY') AS itemType, SI.RESV_ID AS resvId, SI.ROOM_ID AS roomId, SI.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, SI.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, SI.RESV_AMOUNT AS resvAmount, SI.FEE_RATE AS feeRate, SI.FEE_AMOUNT AS feeAmount, SI.SETTLE_AMOUNT AS settleAmount, SI.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, SI.HOLD_REASON AS holdReason, SI.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, SR.NAME AS roomName FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM SI JOIN TB_SETTLEMENT ST ON ST.SETTLE_ID = SI.SETTLE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_RESERVATION R ON R.RESV_ID = SI.RESV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = SI.ROOM_ID WHERE SI.SETTLE_ID = #{settleId} AND ST.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND ST.BIZ_TYPE = 'STAY' ORDER BY SI.CHECKOUT_DATE ASC, SI.SETTLE_ITEM_ID ASC

INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT ( SETTLE_ID, SETTLE_TYPE, RESV_ID, BIZ_NO, PAY_AMOUNT, FEE_RATE, FEE_AMOUNT, SETTLE_STATUS, REG_DATE, BIZ_TYPE, SETTLE_MONTH, TOTAL_SALES, TOTAL_FEE, SETTLE_AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS, PAY_DATE, REQUEST_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, REQUEST_SCOPE, ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, REQUESTED_AT, APPROVED_AT, REJECT_REASON, PRODUCT_SALES_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT, RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{settleId}, #{settleType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{bizNo}, #{payAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{feeRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{feeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{settleStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{bizType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{settleMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalSales, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalFee, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{settleAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{requestId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{requestType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestScope, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roomId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{periodStart, jdbcType=DATE}, #{periodEnd, jdbcType=DATE}, #{requestedAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{approvedAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productSalesAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deliveryFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{returnFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )

SELECT SEQ_TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT_ITEM ( SETTLE_ITEM_ID, SETTLE_ID, ITEM_TYPE, RESV_ID, ROOM_ID, CHECKIN_DATE, CHECKOUT_DATE, RESV_AMOUNT, ORDER_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CONFIRMED_AT, ITEM_SALES_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE_AMOUNT, RETURN_FEE_AMOUNT, RETURN_FEE_PAYER, FEE_RATE, FEE_AMOUNT, SETTLE_AMOUNT, STATUS_CD, HOLD_REASON, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{settleItemId}, #{settleId}, NVL(#{itemType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'STAY'), #{resvId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{roomId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{checkinDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{checkoutDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{resvAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{confirmedAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{itemSalesAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deliveryFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{returnFeeAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{returnFeePayer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{settleAmount}, #{statusCd}, #{holdReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )

mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, BIZ_NO AS bizNo, REQUEST_SCOPE AS requestScope, ROOM_ID AS roomId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, TARGET_START AS targetStart, TARGET_END AS targetEnd, STATUS_CD AS statusCd, REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, REQUESTED_AT AS requestedAt, APPROVED_AT AS approvedAt, REJECTED_AT AS rejectedAt FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST WHERE BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED', APPROVED_AT = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = NULL, REJECTED_AT = NULL WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REJECTED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
